episodes.title: Rosefinch
episodes.summary: Alice searches for her boyfriend Tom, uncovering secrets in his charity that make her question his past and what she thought she knew.

episodes.title: Limerence
episodes.summary: Alice uncovers secrets about Tom as allies turn suspect. After a murder and a deadly chase, she fears he's caught in something darker.

episodes.title: The Fatted Calf
episodes.summary: Alice's doubts about Tom grow as she uncovers his secret ties. After a deadly encounter, she takes a new identity to learn the truth.

episodes.title: Run, Alice, Run
episodes.summary: After escaping captivity, Alice faces dangerous secrets and shifting loyalties, unsure who to trust as she nears the truth.
